meta.title: eiken-practice architecture map
meta.scope: Static Eiken practice app: routing, learning modes, data, persistence, optional integrations, and deployment.
notes: The diagram describes the current code paths, not a proposed rewrite.
q1, q3, dictation, and pre1 instantiate the shared optional cloud helper; q2, paraphrase, and writing currently persist locally.
The serial course aggregates existing mode progress and opens a mode; it does not own answer records.

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.summary: Shared DOM shell: header, app navigation, homePanel, sessionPanel, and script loading.

nodes.label: static/app.js
nodes.summary: Thin router over APPS. Chooses the active path, mounts a mode, updates navigation, and keeps the shared panels reusable.

nodes.label: mode-entry.js
nodes.summary: Loads the manifest, selects 2級 / 準2級 / 準1級, stores the grade profile, and optionally authenticates a shared student URL.

nodes.label: data/manifest.json
nodes.summary: Dataset registry for q1, q2, q3, dictation, and pre1 rounds. It is the runtime routing table for learning data.

nodes.label: mode-serial.js
nodes.summary: Fixed-order course coordinator. Reads per-mode progress, aggregates three-round completion, and unlocks the next primary step.

nodes.label: mode-free.js
nodes.summary: Unlocked skill picker. It applies the current profile and delegates progress ownership to each skill mode.

nodes.label: mode-q1.js · 語彙
nodes.summary: Vocabulary flow: meaning/example cards → meaning check → four-choice practice → wrong review / final check.

nodes.label: mode-q2.js · 空所
nodes.summary: Cloze questions loaded per dataset. Answers and resume state are kept locally by dataset.

nodes.label: mode-paraphrase.js
nodes.summary: Supplementary paraphrase practice with typed answers, structural evaluation, self-rating, and resume state.

nodes.label: mode-writing.js · 英作文
nodes.summary: Structured drafts for essay, summary, and email variants. Steps are persisted locally and review text is copied to an external AI.

nodes.label: mode-dictation.js
nodes.summary: Audio question flow with answer tracking, wrong-answer dictation, scripts, round switching, and resume state.

nodes.label: mode-q3.js · 長文
nodes.summary: Reading flow: four-choice answer → evidence sentence selection → grading → summary completion and review.

nodes.label: mode-pre1.js · 準1級
nodes.summary: Dedicated round/section engine for pre-1: vocabulary, cloze, writing, listening, and reading sections.

nodes.label: data/*.json
nodes.summary: Vocabulary, questions, lessons, paraphrase, writing, and pre-1 round payloads. Loaded at runtime through relative URLs.

nodes.label: assets/audio + clips
nodes.summary: Listening source files: round audio and per-question clips used by dictation and pre-1 listening.

nodes.label: localStorage
nodes.summary: Primary anonymous persistence. Keys are separated by mode, dataset, round, drafts, resume position, and route/profile state.

nodes.label: harness store + engine
nodes.summary: Generated, DOM-free state layer for unit × mode progress, wrong queues, and optional Leitner review scheduling.

nodes.label: harness/cloud.js
nodes.summary: Optional student URL sync. It is a no-op without ?s / ?t or runtime configuration, and debounces saves before RPC calls.

nodes.label: Netlify /api/check-sentence
nodes.summary: Optional server-side sentence check. It validates input, calls OpenAI with a JSON contract, and returns normalized feedback.

nodes.label: Supabase RPC
nodes.summary: Student authentication and progress load/save through app_auth_student, app_load_progress, and app_save_progress.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages workflow
nodes.summary: Push to main generates runtime config, prepares _site, uploads the artifact, and deploys the static site.

nodes.label: Netlify function deploy
nodes.summary: Netlify serves the function directory; the static Pages site can call its configured endpoint for sentence checks.

edges.label: loads

edges.label: mounts

edges.label: mounts

edges.label: reads

edges.label: profile

edges.label: reads
edges.description: Serial loads all three rounds and the matching audio datasets for the active grade.

edges.label: aggregates

edges.label: unlocks

edges.label: unlocks

edges.label: unlocks

edges.label: unlocks
edges.description: Listening follows writing after the round gate.

edges.label: unlocks
edges.description: Reading is the final standard route step.

edges.label: pre1 mode
edges.description: The pre-1 profile uses a dedicated section sequence inside mode-pre1.js.

edges.label: opens any
edges.description: Free practice can open any standard skill without serial locking.

edges.label: opens any
edges.description: The free list delegates directly to writing.

edges.label: pre1 list
edges.description: The pre-1 profile swaps in its five section entries.

edges.label: fetches

edges.label: fetches

edges.label: fetches
edges.description: Paraphrase loads its separate question bank.

edges.label: fetches

edges.label: fetches

edges.label: fetches
edges.description: Pre-1 loads round data and vocabulary from manifest entries.

edges.label: saves

edges.label: saves

edges.label: saves
edges.description: Dictation stores answers by level/round plus a resume pointer.

edges.label: saves
edges.description: Q3 stores question, summary, and resume state per dataset.

edges.label: saves
edges.description: Pre-1 stores round-scoped questions, writing, summaries, final checks, and resume state.

flows.label: 2級 / 準2級 · 学習ルート
flows.description: 固定順の主要ルート。直列側が既存モードの回別進捗を集計して次段階を解放する。

steps.label: 級を選ぶ
steps.action: manifestから級と回を決め、プロフィールをlocalStorageへ保存する。

steps.label: 学習ルートを開く
steps.action: q1 / q2 / 言い換え / 英作文 / リスニング / q3 の順序とゲートを計算する。

steps.label: 大問1（語彙）
steps.action: 意味確認、意味チェック、4択、誤答復習、最終チェックを進める。

steps.label: 大問2（空所補充）
steps.action: 回別の本文と空所問題を解き、データセット別に進捗を保存する。

steps.label: 言い換え（補助）
steps.action: 補助練習を自己判定する。主要3回分のゲート対象外。

steps.label: 英作文
steps.action: 設問タイプに応じた段階入力を保存し、レビュー用テキストを作る。

steps.label: リスニング
steps.action: 音声、4択、誤答書き取りを回別に進める。

steps.label: 大問3（長文）
steps.action: 解答、根拠文、内容整理を完了し、3回分のゲートを閉じる。

flows.label: 2級 / 準2級 · 自由演習
flows.description: 順序ロックを外し、現在の級の技能一覧から直接モードを開く。

steps.label: 級を選ぶ
steps.action: 現在のgrade profileを確定する。

steps.label: 自由演習を開く
steps.action: profileに応じた6技能の一覧を表示する。

steps.label: 任意の技能へ
steps.action: 選んだ技能モードへ直接委譲し、既存の保存領域を使う。

flows.label: 準1級 · 学習ルート
flows.description: 準1級専用モードで、セクション順と3回分の完了を管理する。

steps.label: 準1級を選ぶ
steps.action: pre1 round profileを確定する。

steps.label: pre1の順序を計算
steps.action: 大問1 → ライティング → リスニング → 大問2 → 大問3を5段階で表示する。

steps.label: 準1級モード
steps.action: roundごとに語彙、空所、writing、listening、readingを切り替える。

steps.label: 回別進捗を保存
steps.action: questions / writing / summaries / finalCheck / resumeを同じpre1領域に保存する。

flows.label: 共有URL · Q1クラウド同期
flows.description: 共有URLと設定がある場合だけ、Q1の進捗をローカルからクラウドへ同期する。

steps.label: Q1を開始
steps.action: 語彙データと回答状態を読み込む。

steps.label: 共有URLを確認
steps.action: ?s=<id>&t=<token> と static/config.json が揃う場合だけ同期を有効化する。

steps.label: load / save
steps.action: app_auth_student → app_load_progress、変更後はapp_save_progressへ送る。

steps.label: 匿名時はローカル
steps.action: 共有条件がなければ、従来どおりlocalStorageだけで続行する。

flows.label: 自作英文 · 任意AIチェック
flows.description: Q1の自作英文チェックと英作文の外部レビュー境界を示す。

steps.label: 例文を下書き
steps.action: 対象語を使った自作英文をdataset単位で保存する。

steps.label: 任意エンドポイント
steps.action: 設定された場合だけ、入力検証済みの英文をPOSTする。

steps.label: Netlifyで提供
steps.action: Netlify Functionが/api/check-sentenceとして公開される。

steps.label: 英作文レビュー
steps.action: writingはアプリ内採点ではなく、レビュー用テキストを個人のAIへコピーする。
